messages:
arjun: FYI: I noticed the scorecard compare flow drops the subgroup/prompt-family filter when you open a sample modal. Repro steps: select cohort -> diff -> click a sample -> filter disappears.

mariam: ugh. I saw strange deltas earlier but assumed it was a filter quirk. Can you repro in prod console? :eyes:

arjun: Yep repros on prod and staging. Happens with both quantized and fp16 runs.

lucy: does it only affect the UI state, or the backend query too? i.e. are the modal examples actually unfiltered?

arjun: modal is unfiltered — backend call for sample list loses the "filters" payload. I dumped the network: POST /api/scorecards/samples body is missing "filters" key after modal-open action.

ben: likely regression from the recent compare refactor where we split query params into urlState vs transientState. modal-open probably reads urlState but we only persisted transientState.

mariam: can you paste the payloads?

arjun: snippets:
```
// before opening modal (works)
POST /api/scorecards/samples
{ "filters": { "prompt_family": "faq", "quant": "q4_0" }, "sort": "diff.desc" }

// after opening modal (broken)
POST /api/scorecards/samples
{ "sort": "diff.desc" }
```

lucy: thanks — that pattern screams missing merge in ui/state/utils. i can try a quick PR. might be interaction with the new routing middleware.

ben: assign to lucy, but also add an e2e to CI so we catch this next time. the flakiness window we had for scorecard diffs is already annoying.

mariam: for the short term, can we hack a fallback in the modal that reads filters from url query string and injects into the request if absent?

lucy: yeah will add: if (!payload.filters) payload.filters = parseUrlState(); push PR in ~30m.

arjun: that should unblock analytics folks. Also logging: add eval-bot tag to these requests so we can grep.

eval-bot: automated note: created issue ELV-4321 linking to screenshots and network logs.

ben: once fix lands, let's add a small dashboard check: open compare -> open sample -> assert backend request contains filters. run as part of smoke for eval-harness deploys.

mariam: tagging owners: @lucy for fix, @arjun to validate, @ben to add smoke test. thanks all :thumbsup:
